judgement.reason: WeKan can use FerretDB with PostgreSQL, a supported setting, so the contained-change outcome stands.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported container setup: the start script releases/ferretdb/wekan-entrypoint.sh runs 2 long-running servers in the background (--log-level=error, node /build/recovery-bridge.mjs) in one container. Deployz runs one web process and declared workers as separate services.
reviews.reason: The shown lines confirm that the entrypoint can start a bundled FerretDB server, and nothing shown proves that the production path avoids it or the recovery bridge, so the vendor should confirm.
